title: 'Just Because' Board
seo_title: Easy 'Just Because' Charcuterie Board for Two (Under $25)
description: An easy charcuterie board for two from what's in the fridge: sharp cheddar, a small brie, salami, apple, grapes, nuts, honey and mustard. About $12 to $22.
hook: No occasion, maximum impact: a weeknight board for two that you can mostly build from the fridge and pantry.
why: This is the cheapest board in the book because it leans on things you probably have: sharp cheddar, a small brie or Camembert, salami, an apple and grapes, nuts, honey, Dijon and whatever crackers are in the cupboard.
It still follows the formula that makes a board work: something sharp, something creamy, something salty and something sweet, with a sour bite from cornichons to reset between them.

timeline.what: Check the fridge and pantry first.
Quick shop for one or two items if needed.
Take the cheese out if you remember.

faq.q: How do you make a quick charcuterie board for two?
faq.a: Start with one sharp cheese and one soft one, add salami, sliced apple and grapes, a handful of nuts, honey or mustard, cornichons and crackers. It takes about 10 minutes.
About $12 to $22, depending on what you already have. The cheeses are the biggest cost.
Yes. Any firm cheese works for the cheddar and any soft one for the brie. Pears work instead of apple.
